quest.title: Downtown
quest.description: Who would have guessed — Madame Ping is an adeptus! After leaving her household, which turned out to be a realm within a teapot, you proceed to Chihu Rock to continue preparations.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x575, Primogem x30, Mora x19800, Adventurer's Experience x7, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Ah, sir, you're here. The seven kites you asked for have been made to order. Would you like to take them now?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Yes. Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: It's rare to see customers who want to buy this type of kite nowadays. In the early days, we used to get orders from people of all walks of life...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, this is Mr. Zhongli from the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor, so he's probably well-versed in all these walks of life.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've talked about a whole bunch of things while traveling with him...

choices.text: Fashion, economics, jewelry and jade pottery...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He seems to know Liyue's favorite topics, money and government, really well, but he likes talking about less useful topics instead.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Well, that's because I prefer to share fun things with you.

response.speaker: Granny Shan
response.text: Children's toys are very fun things, that's for sure. I enjoy watching the children at play as much as anyone else. But there is more to it than that.

response.speaker: Granny Shan
response.text: Finely crafted toys are well-loved by children. But this craft itself has been honed over thousands of years, and there is meaning behind that.

response.speaker: Granny Shan
response.text: I have made kites in Liyue for forty years, and I am intimately familiar with the forms passed down from my ancestors. The meaning of these seven kites is far from banal.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Indeed. These are decorations used in the Rite of Parting. The seven kites represent The Seven.

response.speaker: Granny Shan
response.text: I took the liberty of coloring outside the lines when doing the insignia of the Anemo Archon.

response.speaker: Granny Shan
response.text: As for the kite that honors the Geo Archon, one must follow the contract given right down to the last letter. These patterns are ancient, and you can also find them in the Golden House.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, Paimon's heard that name before—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: The design of this kite displays a firm grasp on the cyclicality and eternity so dear to the Electro Archon.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: These markings of tree and leaf pay due honor to wisdom and the passage of time. All this, on a single kite — truly astonishing.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Justice flows across the surface of the waters, war rages like a flame, as does that which the Cryo Archon once... yes, these details are masterfully done.

response.speaker: Granny Shan
response.text: Hehehe, the compliments of a learned man truly are pleasant.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Well then, Granny Shan, I shall take these back with me. As for the payment...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Well, allow me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, it's Childe!

choices.text: Did you arrange to meet here?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Haha. No, I was merely passing through.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: I see Mr. Zhongli's the same as ever. When paying— Well, when getting others to pay for him, he neither looks at the price tag nor his wallet.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: He knows a great deal about money, and about the trials of the common man. He just doesn't consider poverty to be something that could ever happen to him.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Or perhaps you could say that he cannot imagine himself lacking money.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How has he not died of hunger yet?

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: ...Childe, you are as fond of jokes as ever. Well then, since we've purchased our kites without incident, there's no need to take a break before moving to the next step in our preparations.

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: The Rite of Parting requires helping hands as well as materials. We should be able to find some people near the harbor.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: #Oh, by the way, {NICKNAME}, take this bag of money. You probably won't want to let Zhongli do the bargaining, if you know what I mean.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Hmm... It seems I missed out on some interesting information.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: ...I suppose I'll just have to find a more opportune moment next time.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Haha, no way. I was just passing through!

dialogues.speaker: Tic
dialogues.text: Oh? Help? Sure! I, Tic, always put in one hundred percent effort into everything I do! Of course, there'll be a premium if you want me to give a hundred and ten percent.

dialogues.speaker: Tic
dialogues.text: So, what's the job?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Let me see... we are still missing some wooden implements over at Yujing Terrace. They aren't uncommon objects, so I didn't make any special preparations for them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Fetch me 50 tree branches, and 20 stacks of timber!

dialogues.speaker: Tic
dialogues.text: No problem. That'll be <color=#00E1FFFF>twenty thousand Mora</color> for a single trip. How does that sound?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Done.

dialogues.speaker: Tic
dialogues.text: You're mad! And to think I was so willing to bargain, too! Twenty thousand Mora, and not one Mora less! If not, the deal's off!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey, don't get mad... Ah, guess we have no choice but to pay in full, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Tic
dialogues.text: Oh? Help? Sure! I, Tic, always put in one hundred percent effort into everything I do! Of course, there'll be a premium if you want me to give a hundred and ten percent.

dialogues.speaker: Tic
dialogues.text: So, what's the job?

dialogues.speaker: Tic
dialogues.text: No problem. That'll be <color=#00E1FFFF>twenty thousand Mora</color> for a single trip. How does that sound?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Done.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ugh, we brought too little money...

dialogues.speaker: Tic
dialogues.text: This is all you've got? Then no can do.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Please go look for someone named Childe...

dialogues.speaker: Tic
dialogues.text: Childe? No, no, no. He's putting up the money? Still, no. Wouldn't that mean that I have to make two trips rather than one?

dialogues.speaker: Tic
dialogues.text: How about this. Let's make a trade. I'll take what you're offering right now, and...

dialogues.speaker: Tic
dialogues.text: Get me a single <color=#00E1FFFF>Qingxin flower</color>, and I'll consider that payment for a detour to find this Childe fellow. How does that sound?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess we've got no choice.

talks.objective: Give the Qingxin flower to Tic

dialogues.speaker: Tic
dialogues.text: Have you brought the goods?

dialogues.speaker: Tic
dialogues.text: Hey, that's pretty good. These things are pretty rare, and I have no idea where I'd find them.

dialogues.speaker: Tic
dialogues.text: With this Qingxin flower, I should be able to pacify my daughter tonight. I'll make sure the work is done before I return home.

dialogues.speaker: Tac
dialogues.text: A full day of odd jobs at Yujing Terrace? Hmm... No problem. <color=#00E1FFFF>Twenty-five thousand</color> per day. A fair trade, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, that's expensive. Um, could you give us a bit of a discount on account of the whole Hero of Mondstadt thing?

dialogues.speaker: Tac
dialogues.text: Hero of Mondstadt? Never heard of them.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Well, you may never have heard of this hero, but it seems you've heard of Mora nonetheless, thus I will simply pay the whole sum.

dialogues.speaker: Tac
dialogues.text: That's enough! I'm done! Twenty-five thousand, and not a Mora less! Take it or leave it!

dialogues.speaker: Tac
dialogues.text: Find me a high-quality <color=#00E1FFFF>Lotus Head</color>. I'll consider that my detour fee paid, and go find what's-his-face Childe. How about it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon

talks.objective: Give the Lotus Head to Tac

dialogues.speaker: Tac
dialogues.text: Have you brought the goods?

dialogues.speaker: Tac
dialogues.text: Oh, that looks good. I'm hitting the kitchen tonight, and it's not often that I get to use such fresh and high-end ingredients...

dialogues.speaker: Tac
dialogues.text: Well, I'll head to Yujing Terrace in a moment. I won't be late!

dialogues.speaker: Toe
dialogues.text: Hiring help? Sure, but let me just say first that I'm a reserve member of the Adventurers' Guild. I take adventuring commissions, but I don't do anything clerical.

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: Adventure... venturing into the mountains to capture a few crystalflies seems adventurous enough.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Brave adventurer, we have need of 5 crystalflies.

dialogues.speaker: Toe
dialogues.text: Eh? That's not hard, almost a bit too easy for a reserve adventurer... Eh, never mind. I'll only charge you <color=#00E1FFFF>fifteen thousand Mora</color>. What say you?

dialogues.speaker: Zhongli
dialogues.text: A most fair price.

dialogues.speaker: Toe
dialogues.text: Fifteen thousand Mora, not one less! That's the lowest I'm going, end of story!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess we've got no choice.

talks.objective: Give the Iron Chunk to Toe

dialogues.speaker: Toe
dialogues.text: Have you brought the goods?

dialogues.speaker: Toe
dialogues.text: Mm, this is good ore. As an adventurer, one must have a trusty weapon by one's side...

dialogues.speaker: Toe
dialogues.text: This'll work. Once I've finished, I will go and claim my payment.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: All finished then? Splendid. Any leftover cash is yours to keep — a favor for the Fatui should never go unrewarded.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You think you can buy us off with some loose change? No way! Paimon demands to know when the next payment is coming!

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Haha. Well, how does this sound: You give me the information I need, and maybe I'll leave the Northland Bank's vaults open and unattended for half an hour...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What info do you need!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Huh? {NICKNAME}, does that mean you know what he's after?

choices.text: What else could the Fatui want?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yikes! You're right, Signora...

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: #You both need to calm down... I don't know what's gotten into you, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Just what is this about? The atmosphere got so tense all of a sudden.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ehh...

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Next, we need some Everlasting Incense. For this, we need to go to Bubu Pharmacy, the finest pharmacy in all of—

response.speaker: Zhongli
response.text: Is... everything okay?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Everything is fine. I was just informing them that they need not return the surplus Mora.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Now, if you'll excuse me, I must be going.

choices.text: Are you forgetting what happened in Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Tic
dialogues.text: Have you brought the goods?

dialogues.speaker: Tac
dialogues.text: Have you brought the goods?

dialogues.speaker: Toe
dialogues.text: Have you brought the goods?

dialogues.speaker: Toe
dialogues.text: Let's see... No. Go higher, or I'm not doing this.

dialogues.speaker: Toe
dialogues.text: That won't do, I'm afraid. It's too little! Too little, I say!

dialogues.speaker: Toe
dialogues.text: Five Geo Crystalflies... Yes, I do think it's worth about this much. I'll do it.

dialogues.speaker: Toe
dialogues.text: A pleasure doing business with you.

dialogues.speaker: Tac
dialogues.text: This... is too little. I'd consider it if it was a bit higher.

dialogues.speaker: Tac
dialogues.text: That's too little. Hardly a fair price.

dialogues.speaker: Tac
dialogues.text: This price'll do. No loss to me for a day's work.

dialogues.speaker: Tac
dialogues.text: Hey, that's a good price. Anyone would work for this much Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Tic
dialogues.text: Huh? No, no... How about a bit more. This amount isn't worth going out of the way to make only one trip.

dialogues.speaker: Tic
dialogues.text: Oh, come on, that's too little.

dialogues.speaker: Tic
dialogues.text: Let me think... Deal. This price is reasonable. I'll hop right to it.

dialogues.speaker: Tic
dialogues.text: Oh? You're a straight shooter, huh? We have a deal.
